note: A bundle's pay is the SUM of its orders' earnings (reward model: earnings = sum(order.earnings)).

question_text: Inside a store, if you are at the apple aisle, how do you add an apple to your bag?
note: Items are added by typing the name, choosing a quantity, then Add to bag (DetailedAction vocab: item entry -> add_item_to_bag).

question_text: Uh oh! I added too many apples. How can I remove apples from my bag? Select all that apply.
note: Correct set for this 'select all that apply' item is {6,7}: the minus button decreases quantity (decrease_item_quantity) - a valid removal.

question_text: Uh oh! I added too many apples. How can I remove apples from my bag? Select all that apply.
note: Correct set is {6,7}: the red X removes the item (remove_item_from_bag) - a valid removal. Option 8 (plus) is incorrect (it adds).
